details:
1. When trying to use the in-game keyboard, it decides to re-open itself for some reason when I try to set letters to upper case (failing to turn on the upper case).

1.1 As well as when I press the right top corner x to close it.

1.2 Or clicking on literally anything on the board that is not a key.

2. On desktop, you can make the keyboard huge, hiding part of it along with the part that let's you scale it, so I guess you're stuck with that, unless you open your keyboard on the settings search tab that spawns it in the corner (which I don't like, I'm used to always having game keyboards being in the center of the screen, so it feels inconvenient by trying to be more convenient)

I'm not a fan of this keyboard update, I don't understand why there are so any UI changes (aside from the new desktop HUD, that's gonna give new desktop players a much easier time), most of it was already fine before. Being able to move the keyboard is cool and all, but I can't think of a single scenario where I'd actually do that.
title: Keyboard is very broken
